determinism.canonicalization: strict duplicate-rejecting compact sorted ASCII JSON with one LF, NFC strings, exact built-in types, bounded integers, no floats, and complete lowercase SHA-256 identities; each schema object's self-identity hashes its complete canonical object with only that object's own digest field null
determinism.classification: the closed two-axis disposition and cause table, all 49 accepted portfolio status/reason pairs, governed outcome discriminators, source phase, precedence row, resource dimensions, diagnostic codes, evidence milestones, nullability, and authority ceiling are fixed by the five normative schemas and this accepted contract; every invalid or internal result has exactly one static diagnostic and every ordinary result has none
determinism.inputs: the request binds the exact planning request, route result, planning result, optional base budget, sorted unique descriptor inventory, plan-order binding inventory, exact ordered role and artifact inventory, invocation identity, and optional intent before the first execution effect
determinism.invocation: invocation_sha256 is SHA-256 of one canonical mathhead.execution-disposition-invocation.v1 projection containing exactly schema, invocation_id, planning_request_sha256, route_result_sha256, planning_result_sha256, base_parent_budget_sha256, descriptor_sha256s, binding_sha256s, artifact_bindings, cancellation_armed, and mathematical_authority=false; it excludes cancellation_intent, invocation_sha256, request_sha256, anchored budget, portfolio request, paths, workspace, and Event

determinism.request_identity: after invocation_sha256 is fixed, optional intent_sha256 hashes the complete canonical intent with only intent_sha256 null, then request_sha256 hashes the complete canonical disposition request including that intent with only request_sha256 null; the order invocation projection, optional intent, disposition request, budget anchor is acyclic
determinism.runtime_exclusions: clock samples, scheduling, Event object identity or final state, arrival order, executable and workspace path spelling, PID, handle, signal, exception text, raw diagnostics, environment, host, user, and mutable aliases never enter canonical identities

effects.environment: none added or retained; no ambient signal, environment, host, user, locale, path search, credential, or secret discovery occurs

ensures: execute_with_disposition validates one canonical disposition request against every supplied semantic byte input, freshly recomputes the accepted route and deterministic plan, and returns one final immutable ExecutionDispositionBundle with zero mathematical authority for every ordinary governed outcome.

The planning_result argument is never trusted as caller-authored status: plan_strategies is invoked over the exact planning request, route result, descriptor tuple, and artifact-byte projection, and its canonical bytes must equal the supplied planning result before any execution effect.

A valid non-planned result classified as invalid, unsupported, ambiguous, or exhausted has base_parent_budget, bindings, executable_paths, workspace_root, cancellation intent, and Event absent as required by the early branch; it launches no process and returns invalid_request, unsupported_input or unsupported_execution_environment, ambiguity, or budget_exhaustion from exact governed status and reason only.

A valid planned result requires one exact canonical open base parent budget, one nonempty exact workspace root, complete plan-order bindings and executable identity paths, and an optional intent paired if and only if one exact threading.Event is supplied; malformed shape returns invalid_request before launch.

The cancellation intent is immutable canonical data binding one invocation ID, one invocation-scoped intent ID, origin user, parent, or supervisor, one closed reason, the exact invocation_sha256 projection, the exact base-budget identity, and the accepted execution-disposition policy identity; its own hash and every duplicated relation are independently recomputed.

The disposition request identity is computed only after its acyclic invocation projection and optional intent and excludes the not-yet-derived anchored-budget and portfolio-request identities. Before execution the coordinator inserts only the reserved org.mathhead.execution-disposition extension containing the validated embedded request_sha256 as disposition_request_sha256, preserves every other base-budget field exactly, validates the anchored ledger open, and proves the strip-only byte round trip.

The portfolio request is derived inside the boundary from the fresh planning result, anchored parent budget, exact descriptors, plan-order bindings, and ordered role and artifact bytes by make_proof_search_portfolio_request; no caller-supplied portfolio request is accepted.

For one valid planned branch, execute_audited_run is invoked exactly once with the derived portfolio request and anchored budget, exact semantic inputs, effect-only paths, workspace, and the same exact Event instance unchanged; no ordinary outcome invokes it again.

After the sole audited call returns, replay_run_audit is invoked once more over the exact returned manifest and object tuple before any normal presentation. Only status complete with reason REPLAY_COMPLETE and exact manifest, report, portfolio, provenance, budget, plan, request, and object relations permits ordinary terminal classification. Replay status invalid pairs only with REPLAY_INVALID, exhausted pairs only with REPLAY_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, and either failure is internal_error rather than execution-budget exhaustion.

The result truthfully tags execution evidence as not_started, attempted_no_bundle, bundle_replay_failed, or replayed_complete and separately tags the portfolio relation as not_available, exact, or invalid. Every state after execution started requires validated disposition-request and invocation identities plus exact routed/ROUTED and planned/PLANNED status. Internal cleanup requires replayed_complete exact evidence, audit phase permits attempted_no_bundle or replayed_complete-invalid evidence, and replay phase permits only bundle_replay_failed evidence; no phase may claim evidence from a step not reached. A not_started result always has audit, logical-report, replay, portfolio-result, provenance, portfolio-status, and replay-status evidence absent, while base, anchor, and derived portfolio-request identities are governed by the exact reached prelaunch milestone rather than globally erased. request_input_sha256 is always SHA-256 of the exact raw disposition_request bytes, while disposition_request_sha256 is the validated embedded request_sha256 and remains null until canonical, schema, and self-identity validation succeeds; these digests are normally different and invalid identities are never repaired. The result never fabricates manifest, report, replay, portfolio, provenance, selected artifact, or authority identities for early or failed capture branches.

The prelaunch evidence matrix is closed. REQUEST_INVALID retains no validated request, invocation, armed flag, intent, route, plan, budget, anchor, or portfolio identity. A request-phase intent, binding, or artifact mismatch retains only a validated request. ROUTE_INPUT_INVALID retains either no route pair or exact invalid/INVALID_INPUT and no planning evidence. Planner invalid retains exact routed/ROUTED plus invalid/INVALID_INPUT; a post-plan binding failure retains routed/ROUTED plus planned/PLANNED. EXECUTION_INPUT_INVALID retains a complete planned relation but no validated budget, anchor, or portfolio request. RESERVED_EXTENSION_COLLISION and BUDGET_ANCHOR_INVALID retain the complete planned relation and base-budget identity but no anchor or portfolio request. PORTFOLIO_REQUEST_INVALID additionally retains the validated anchor but no portfolio request. Coordinator limit exhaustion occurs before validated retention or effect; no generic coordinator or classification-invariant result branch may reuse a reached milestone.

The accepted run-logical-report-v3 catalogue contains exactly 49 portfolio status/reason pairs, reproduced exhaustively by execution-disposition-result-v1. Every exact pair has one ordinary cause, one exact internal invariant owner, or one named governed discriminator; no unlisted pair, generic catch-all, prose inference, or diagnostic substitution is accepted.

The closed cause catalogue is checked_proof, checked_refutation, ambiguity, user_cancellation, parent_cancellation, supervisor_cancellation, cancellation_origin_unproven, budget_exhaustion, unsupported_input, unsupported_execution_environment, producer_refusal, verifier_refusal, truncation, inconclusive_execution, checker_disagreement, invalid_evidence, producer_failure, verifier_failure, invalid_request, and internal_error, with the exact disposition and precedence relations in execution-disposition-classification-v1.

Checked proof and checked refutation require a freshly replayed complete succeeded portfolio with exact CHECKED_PROOF or CHECKED_REFUTATION reason and the retained selected strategy, Evidence, Certificate, checker decision, and upstream linked authority tier. The disposition itself has authority_ceiling none and mathematical_authority false.

User, parent, or supervisor cancellation requires the matching precommitted intent origin, the same armed Event passed to the sole audited call, a freshly replayed terminal worker cancelled/CANCELLED observation, complete tree cleanup, exact parent reconciliation with cancelled child outcome, and no higher-precedence invariant failure. The coordinator never samples final Event state for classification.

For every result with a validated request, result.disposition_request_sha256 equals request.request_sha256, result.invocation_sha256 equals request.invocation_sha256, and result.cancellation_armed equals request.cancellation_armed. If armed is false the result cancellation-intent identity is null; if armed is true it equals the independently recomputed embedded cancellation_intent.intent_sha256. A result without a validated request has request, invocation, armed, and intent identity all null. Cancellation classifications additionally require the exact request intent origin matching user, parent, or supervisor; an arbitrary, swapped, copied, or repaired intent digest fails the bundle relation and cannot classify cancellation.

Audit v5 does not retain child ResourceBudget bytes. For a genuine observed cancellation, observer_source supervisor is therefore an explicit projection from replayed worker cancelled/CANCELLED plus the exact accepted worker contract and execution-provenance binding, observer_basis is replayed_worker_status_plus_accepted_contract, and observer_cancellation_id remains null rather than pretending the child ledger was replayed.

Strict intent and Event pairing plus coordinator-owned anchoring makes cancellation_origin_unproven unreachable for a genuine v1 coordinator execution. The value remains schema-closed for historical or future separately contracted verification, while a substituted, stale, mismatched, or unanchored bundle returned by the sole audited boundary is internal_error and can never become user cancellation.

Budget exhaustion requires either an accepted early route or planning exhaustion with an empty dimension tuple, an independently recomputed nonempty set of unavailable dimensions for BUDGET_INSUFFICIENT, or complete replayed worker exhaustion and reconciliation. WALL_TIME_EXHAUSTED, CPU_TIME_EXHAUSTED, MEMORY_EXHAUSTED, OUTPUT_EXHAUSTED, and DIAGNOSTIC_EXHAUSTED map respectively and exclusively to wall_time_us, cpu_time_us, memory_bytes, output_bytes, and diagnostic_bytes.

Producer Evidence or checker Certificate that merely reports exhausted or cancelled is respectively producer_refusal or verifier_refusal unless independent accepted ledger evidence establishes global exhaustion; no component self-report creates user cancellation or a parent resource fact.

For route NO_COMPATIBLE_CAPABILITY, each exact incompatibility group identified by descriptor_sha256 and capability_id is independently recomputed. Structural blockers are AMBIGUITY_UNSUPPORTED, ARITHMETIC_MISMATCH, CAPABILITY_KIND_MISMATCH, CERTIFICATE_FORMAT_MISMATCH, DOMAIN_MISMATCH, EVIDENCE_FORMAT_MISMATCH, EXPRESSION_KIND_MISMATCH, FEATURE_FORBIDDEN, FEATURE_REQUIRED, LIMIT_EXCEEDED, OPERATION_MISMATCH, QUANTIFIER_MISMATCH, RELATION_KIND_MISMATCH, and THEORY_MISMATCH. Availability blockers are DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE, EFFECT_FORBIDDEN, EXTENSION_UNAVAILABLE, LIFECYCLE_UNAVAILABLE, PLATFORM_UNAVAILABLE, and PYTHON_VERSION_UNAVAILABLE. An empty registered descriptor inventory, or at least one recomputed group with no structural blocker and one or more availability blockers, yields unsupported_execution_environment; otherwise the result is unsupported_input.

REPLAY_MODE_UNAVAILABLE is never accepted at face value: it is a structural blocker when the requested mode is absent from the descriptor operation or plugin supported-replay set, and an availability blocker only when both intrinsic sets support the mode but the exact availability replay_modes set does not. If both intrinsic and ambient support it, retaining the reason is an internal relation error.

ISOLATION_UNSUPPORTED and exact missing host capabilities are unsupported_execution_environment. Producer Evidence unsupported and checker Certificate unsupported are producer_refusal and verifier_refusal. Unsupported, refusal, ambiguity, exhaustion, truncation, and inconclusive outcomes never mean false, refuted, inconsistent, or impossible.

Producer_failure requires the final complete freshly replayed producer terminal with exact EXIT_FAILED, PROTOCOL_FAILED, EVIDENCE_ERROR, or the accepted producer launch-precondition relation; verifier_failure requires the final complete freshly replayed checker terminal with exact EXIT_FAILED, PROTOCOL_FAILED, CERTIFICATE_INVALID, or the accepted checker launch-precondition relation. Producer LAUNCH_FAILED is component failure only for outer failed/LAUNCH_FAILED whose final attempt is producer_error with producer refused/LAUNCH_FAILED, no Evidence, checker not_started, a matching producer worker observation, unchanged parent ledger for that refused worker, a terminal failed transition, portfolio_relation exact, and portfolio_outcome_kind launch_refused. Checker LAUNCH_FAILED has the analogous verifier_failed relation and the same launch_refused discriminator. A prior fallback launch refusal never outranks the final terminal attempt. A low-level worker failed/LAUNCH_FAILED without containment and reconciliation cannot survive as complete portfolio evidence and is internal_error at the audited boundary; any replay-complete but mismatched LAUNCH relation has portfolio_relation invalid and is AUDIT_RELATION_INVALID. EXECUTABLE_INVALID with an exact refused worker is component refusal and carries executable_refused; the same outer pair with an exact invalid worker is internal_error with executable_invalid and WORKER_EXECUTABLE_INVARIANT; a missing or mismatched relation is AUDIT_RELATION_INVALID.

Evidence incomplete is ambiguity; Evidence or Certificate truncation is truncation. The shared outer inconclusive/CHECKER_INCONCLUSIVE pair is verifier_refusal only when the freshly replayed checker decision binds Certificate verdict unsupported and portfolio_outcome_kind certificate_unsupported, and is inconclusive_execution only for Certificate verdict inconclusive and certificate_inconclusive; a missing or mismatched decision, Certificate, or verdict relation is AUDIT_RELATION_INVALID. Exact checker rejection or disagreement is checker_disagreement; malformed or protocol-limited producer Evidence is invalid_evidence. Exact upstream status, reason, portfolio relation, and governed outcome discriminator remain separately bound in the result.

The exact internal terminal table maps failed or verifier_failed REQUEST_INVALID, PLAN_INVALID, STRATEGY_MISMATCH, and BUDGET_INVALID respectively to coordinator WORKER_REQUEST_INVARIANT, WORKER_PLAN_INVARIANT, WORKER_STRATEGY_INVARIANT, and WORKER_BUDGET_INVARIANT; TREE_CLEANUP_FAILED maps to cleanup CLEANUP_INVARIANT; SUPERVISOR_FAILED maps to coordinator SUPERVISOR_INVARIANT; invalid PORTFOLIO_INPUT_INVALID and PORTFOLIO_EXECUTION_INVALID map respectively to coordinator PORTFOLIO_INPUT_INVARIANT and PORTFOLIO_EXECUTION_INVARIANT. Worker-origin, cleanup, and supervisor rows require their exact final role-specific attempt, observation, ledger, transition, and audit relation. PORTFOLIO_INPUT_INVALID instead requires the accepted prelaunch-invalid portfolio shape with zero attempts and worker observations, null portfolio ledger endpoints, and unchanged forensic ledger. PORTFOLIO_EXECUTION_INVALID requires complete replay of the exact accepted zero-or-partial retained attempt and ledger prefix produced by the portfolio exception boundary and never fabricates a final failure attempt. Any row whose required shape or cross-link mismatches instead has portfolio_relation invalid and AUDIT_RELATION_INVALID. These outcomes cannot be laundered into cancellation, exhaustion, refusal, producer failure, verifier failure, or success.

Invalid_request permits only REQUEST_INVALID, INTENT_EVENT_MISMATCH, RESERVED_EXTENSION_COLLISION, ROUTE_INPUT_INVALID, PLANNING_INPUT_INVALID, BINDING_INPUT_INVALID, ARTIFACT_INPUT_INVALID, or EXECUTION_INPUT_INVALID diagnostics. Internal_error permits only BUDGET_ANCHOR_INVALID, PORTFOLIO_REQUEST_INVALID, AUDITED_EXECUTION_INVALID, AUDIT_REPLAY_INVALID, AUDIT_REPLAY_EXHAUSTED, AUDIT_RELATION_INVALID, CLEANUP_INVARIANT, SUPERVISOR_INVARIANT, WORKER_REQUEST_INVARIANT, WORKER_PLAN_INVARIANT, WORKER_STRATEGY_INVARIANT, WORKER_BUDGET_INVARIANT, WORKER_EXECUTABLE_INVARIANT, PORTFOLIO_INPUT_INVARIANT, PORTFOLIO_EXECUTION_INVARIANT, or COORDINATOR_LIMIT_EXHAUSTED diagnostics. Every invalid or internal result retains exactly one diagnostic whose phase equals the classification phase; ordinary results retain none.

Every v1 diagnostic is the exact static projection for its code and phase: diagnostic_id is execution_disposition.<phase>.<lowercase_code>, severity is error, subject_sha256 is null, related_sha256s is empty, mathematical_authority is false, and diagnostic_sha256 is independently recomputed with only its own hash field null. The result already carries all reached evidence identities, so a diagnostic cannot add arbitrary or redundant context, a second diagnostic, a duplicate ID, or an alternative canonical byte representation. Exception spelling, traceback, message text, raw stdout or stderr, path, argv, environment, credential, secret, PID, signal, host, user, and machine-specific wording are absent.

The returned bundle contains an optional validated ExecutionDispositionRequest, one required ExecutionDispositionResult, and optional RunAuditBundle and RunAuditReplayResult values. Its request is null exactly when disposition_request_sha256 is null; otherwise every duplicated request, invocation, armed, and intent identity is byte-exact to that request. Audit and replay values follow the execution_state evidence shape. It retains only immutable canonical values required for independent checking and does not retain raw invalid request bytes, an Event, executable path, workspace path, process, handle, clock sample, callable, module, stream, iterator, or mutable alias.

No cache or store entry, historical cancellation or refusal, copied classification, repaired hash, caller-authored audit, partial replay, filename, missing output, free text, final Event state, timing, or exception can create a current checked, cancelled, exhausted, supported, or authority-bearing result.

MemoryError, KeyboardInterrupt, and SystemExit propagate unchanged according to accepted cleanup behavior and are never serialized as a disposition, diagnostic, success, cancellation, refusal, exhaustion, producer failure, verifier failure, or internal error.

epistemics.authority: the execution-disposition record is adapter-neutral presentation metadata with mathematical_authority false and authority_ceiling none; it may link but never create, copy, repair, upgrade, or restate upstream mathematical authority
epistemics.cancellation: a non-mathematical execution fact requiring both precommitted origin and freshly replayed observation; it neither proves nor refutes the problem and does not authenticate the physical human or remote principal
epistemics.checked: only an already independently checked upstream Evidence, Certificate, checker decision, and accepted trust tier may support linked checked proof or refutation
epistemics.exhaustion: a bounded resource outcome supported by accepted preflight capacity or replayed ledger and worker evidence; it is not cancellation, unsupported mathematics, refutation, or internal failure
epistemics.internal: a closed failure to maintain the coordinator, audit, replay, cleanup, provenance, or cross-layer invariant and grants no execution or mathematical claim beyond the bounded failure phase
epistemics.refusal: a producer, verifier, environment, or structural capability decision that does not imply truth, falsehood, impossibility, or mathematical inconsistency
epistemics.truth: never inferred from execution completion, process exit, cache state, audit completeness, request identity, cancellation, exhaustion, unsupported status, filename, diagnostic text, or disposition serialization

Request validation precedes planning effects, fresh planning precedes branch classification, anchoring precedes portfolio-request derivation, derivation precedes the sole audited call, and the additional fresh replay completes before normal classification and serialization.

Descriptor identities are sorted and unique, binding identities preserve exact plan order and are unique, artifact bindings preserve exact argument order with unique roles and exact length and digest, and every aggregate is bounded before retention.

The disposition request has exactly one invocation_sha256 and request_sha256. Any repaired inner or outer hash or transplanted intent with changed invocation input fails before launch.

Global anti-replay state is outside this boundary: byte-identical reuse of the exact same canonical invocation is observationally the same invocation, while reuse against any changed invocation ID or semantic input fails its bound identity. No durable uniqueness claim is fabricated.

The reserved root extension is owned exclusively by this contract and a pre-existing org.mathhead.execution-disposition key is invalid even when its payload appears equal. No existing extension, budget ID, lineage, policy, limits, events, outcome, or unrelated byte changes during anchoring.

A non-planned branch has no base budget, anchor, portfolio request, audit, replay, cancellation intent, Event, bindings, executable paths, or workspace. A planned branch has exact base, anchor, plan, portfolio, and effect inputs before the audited call.

Intent is present if and only if cancellation_armed is true and the exact Event is present; an intent without Event, Event without intent, early armed intent, mismatched intent, or wrong Event type is invalid_request and launches no work. Result request, invocation, armed, and intent fields form exactly null/null/null/null, SHA/SHA/false/null, or SHA/SHA/true/SHA and are independently equal to the retained validated request.

The Event is effect-only: the coordinator passes the same object unchanged once and never serializes, retains, copies, compares, polls, clears, sets, timestamps, or classifies from its object identity or final state.

One valid planned invocation performs exactly one execute_audited_run call and one additional replay_run_audit call. No direct worker, portfolio rerun, producer, checker, cache, store, audit-store, retry, speculation, fallback, or late presentation effect is reachable.

Only the final reached portfolio outcome is classified; earlier fallback attempts remain replayed history and cannot outrank a later checked terminal result. The fixed precedence rows are internal invariant, prelaunch invalid, early route or planner, checked terminal, observed cancellation, ledger exhaustion, environment refusal, component refusal, semantic terminal, and phase failure.

Cause and disposition pairings, all 49 upstream pairs, outcome discriminators, precedence rank, phase, cancellation-origin fields, observer basis, resource dimensions, selected identities, linked authority tier, execution-state and reached-milestone evidence nullability, cancellation-request identity relations, and exact static diagnostic shapes are closed by the normative schemas and independently revalidated in memory.

The six PLAN distinctions user_cancellation, budget_exhaustion, unsupported_input, internal_error, producer_failure, and verifier_failure are distinct canonical causes and no normalization aliases one to another.

Exact route, planning, portfolio, and replay status and reason are retained separately from the normalized classification. Free text, diagnostic prose, exception name, exit folklore, missing output, or filename never selects a cause.

A genuine user cancellation requires an origin user intent in the exact anchored request and replayed cancellation observation from the exact audit graph. A token supplied after execution, stale audit, set-but-unobserved Event, copied intent, or repaired budget extension cannot produce it.

cancellation_origin_unproven is a reserved closed catalogue member that the strict v1 coordinator validates but cannot emit from a genuine invocation; unanchored or mismatched returned execution evidence is the higher-precedence internal_error relation.

Observer source and origin source are different fields. Observer source supervisor is contract-derived only under exact accepted worker and execution-provenance identities; the absent child-ledger bytes make observer_cancellation_id necessarily null in v1.

BUDGET_INSUFFICIENT requires a nonempty independently recomputed unavailable-dimension set. Evidence and Certificate budget references and self-reported exhausted dimensions never substitute for the accepted parent and planned resource relation.

Resource dimensions are sorted unique members of the exact ten ResourceBudget dimensions. No diagnostic or prose inference creates a dimension, and early planning exhaustion may explicitly retain none.

Successful linked identities occur only for checked_proof or checked_refutation after complete replay; every non-checked classification has selected strategy, Evidence, Certificate, checker decision, and linked authority tier absent or none.

All public values are final exact immutable codec-owned dataclasses or tuples; direct construction, subclassing, mutation, alias mutation, dataclass replacement, object.__new__ forgery, copied status, repaired hashes, and pickling cannot create a valid request, intent, result, classification, diagnostic, or bundle.

Every input, string, integer, JSON node, nesting level, descriptor, binding, artifact, intent, diagnostic, strategy, attempt, audit object, audit event, byte aggregate, and replay operation is checked against a finite ceiling before retention or effect.

The coordinator does not change or supersede accepted routing, planning, worker, portfolio, audit, replay, store, cache, ResourceBudget, EngineResult, Evidence, Certificate, problem-session, provenance, or trust-transition semantics and writes no legacy or new persistent state.

Any manifest, report, portfolio, provenance, budget, worker observation, attempt, phase, artifact, contract, schema, implementation, configuration, or trust relation that fails fresh complete replay or exact current-input binding becomes internal_error without partial authority.
